messages:
morgan: heads-up — seeing some weird 'ghosting' 404s on staging for the runbook at /runbooks/kv-cache. Repro: open staging runbook, click the 'prefix cache' shortlink, get a 404. It works when I'm logged in but not in the unauthenticated preview. Anyone own runbooks/shortlink redirects?

doc-scan-bot: automated-scan: found 8 dead links in runbooks/kv-cache on staging. Uploaded full report to https://internal-reports.redwood.dev/runbook-kv-cache-staging-1748881234.json :rotating_light:

lina: I can take initial triage. Likely shortlink host rotated and the mdx still references old shortlinks. Quick approach: grep to find instances and sed to replace the host. Example commands I used locally: `grep -R "shortlinks.oldcdn.com/kv" -n runbooks/` then `sed -i 's/shortlinks.oldcdn.com\/kv/links.redwood.ai\/kv/g' runbooks/*.mdx` — will open a PR with the sed patch + tiny test that resolves links at build time.

alex: I'll open the PR and add a tiny regression test to the docs CI that fetches the preview URLs. @morgan can you confirm the canonical replacement host (links.redwood.ai/kv)?

sam: quick Q — any production impact? I'm not seeing errors in prod logs, seems isolated to staging preview. Might be fine to fast-track.

morgan: confirmed replacement host is links.redwood.ai/kv. No prod alerts; this is preview-only (likely cached redirect expired on the shortlink host). Low risk. @alex please include a short PR note: "fix: replace old shortlink host for kv runbook; add preview link resolution test; no prod impact". Also flag docs/quick-fix for faster CR. :thumbsup:

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes sed replace, a tiny jest test that runs link resolution in the preview build, and CHANGELOG entry. Assigning to @lina for review.

deploy-bot: preview build triggered for PR #1234 — preview available at https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/pr-1234 :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll smoke test the preview now and report back. If build-preview resolves the links, +1 to merge.

morgan: thanks all. quick note: 2 of the 8 dead links were external images hosted on the old CDN; I filed infra ticket INF-4523 to rehost those images on our canonical CDN. Will update this thread when infra confirms.

lina: great — once PR passes tests I'll do a fast review and approve. tagging docs/quick-fix label so oncall can fast-merge if green.

alex: thanks — will add the label and a short rollback bullet in the PR in case we need to revert.

sam: preview looks good for me, links resolved in the runbook page. leaving a short comment on the PR with my smoke-test notes.

morgan: awesome, merging after CI green. Appreciate the quick response team — saved the next docs release from shipping broken previews.
